fields.id: str — unique record id (split-prefixed content hash)
fields.skin: str — story-world skin key used to render the problem
fields.determined: bool — is the queried cell uniquely forced
fields.text: str — the rendered natural-language problem (the model input)
fields.question: str — the question sentence (also the tail of `text`)
fields.answer: str — value SURFACE of the answer, or 'cannot be determined'
fields.trace: str — exact, organ-grounded reasoning trace (sound AC narrowing + exact closer)
fields.entities: list[str] — surface per entity index (JSON in parquet)
fields.values: list[str] — surface per value index (JSON in parquet)
fields.facts: list — structured ground-truth facts (JSON in parquet)
fields.cons: list — extensional CSP (scope, allowed-tuples) for re-verification (JSON in parquet)
fields.seed: int — shard seed that produced the record

exact_verification: rebuild clair.csp.CSP from `cons`, run clair.hard_tasks.fast_dedP, confirm cell[query] == answer_index (singleton) or ABSTAIN.
